title: Owner rule: a whole rewrite that says nothing of the header keeps it
brief: Rewrite the letter: thank Ms Example for yesterday's meeting and confirm that the work starts on 4 December.
judge: The body is a new letter thanking Ms Example for the meeting and confirming a 4 December start. The letterhead header (logo and divider) and the page-number footer are exactly as they were, because the request said nothing about them.

runs.text: Thank you for meeting us yesterday.
I am glad to confirm that the work starts on 4 December.
